_doc: The third use of lock-fleets (owner, 2026-09-28). Read by plan.py (why, the checks it adds), drive.sh (the live compose the emitted dev compose must equal) and assemble_evidence.py (the rig pins that must not change). Everything else the use runs comes from fleet-setup/ and tools/runs/hosts.json.
why: The cards moved: srv1 now holds two RTX 3060 and srv2 a GTX 1660 SUPER (tools/runs/hosts.json, re-declared on 2026-09-26 for srv1 and 2026-09-27 for srv2). Owner: "Lock only what fits now". What fits now is fleet d-srv2-35b, its one unit srv2_35b_32k: the unit srv2 serves, started through the door on 2026-09-27 (records/evidence/2026-09-27-live-srv2/serve-up.json). It has no lock, and its room_mib was carried over from the earlier card and never measured on srv2. The fleets made for the earlier cards are kept in fleet-setup/fleet.2026-09-28.yaml.

Owner, about the live unit on srv2: "Take it down for the campaign". It is taken down through the door, with the file that started it, before srv2's order runs, and brought back up through the door with that same file when the order ends, so srv2 is left as it was found. Live is down for the window, so no emitted compose file is held to a live one (compose_must_match_live is empty).

Owner, about serving: "nothing right now this is a lab session. And a lab session shouldnt care what to serve. If I dont mention it- leave as found." srv1 was found idle: it is read only, through the door, and no unit of this use is placed on it.

Owner, about cards: "Everything is measured. the user picks whats in play and how much. Mcgyvr recommend a setup. On lab everything is measured always." The unit is started as lock-fleets starts every unit; its launch is not narrowed to one card.
srv2's rig id changed with the hardware (fleet.yaml pins rig-cbe770b5…, and the door reads rig-4cc155e5…), so no pin is kept (keep_rig_pins is empty).
The window date is recorded in the log when it runs.
_swap_recorded_not_stopped_on: Owner ruling 2026-09-16 ("Record swap on srv2 too"), as rig-id-relock/use.json records it: on a listed rig assemble_evidence.py files pswpout's start, end and delta and does not stop on its growth; every other stop still applies there. Swap is filed as data: never judged, and never a reason to call a run invalid. srv1 is not listed: the planner refuses a rig no fleet places a unit on.
